info.title: Estimate Task Credits
info.description: Estimate the credits required for a task from its model parameters without creating the task.

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description:
All APIs require authentication via API Key.

Get API Key:
1. Visit [API Key Management Page](https://crun.ai/user-api-key) to get your API Key

Usage:
Add to request header:

x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY

Note:
- Keep your API Key secure and do not share it with others
- If you suspect your API Key has been compromised, reset it immediately in the management page

code.description:
Response status code

- **200**: Success - Request has been processed successfully
- **401**: Unauthorized - Authentication credentials are missing or invalid
- **402**: Insufficient Credits - Account does not have enough credits to perform the operation
- **404**: Not Found - The requested resource or endpoint does not exist
- **422**: Validation Error - The request parameters failed validation checks
- **429**: Rate Limited - Request limit has been exceeded for this resource
- **455**: Service Unavailable - System is currently undergoing maintenance
- **500**: Server Error - An unexpected error occurred while processing the request
- **501**: Generation Failed - Content generation task failed
- **505**: Feature Disabled - The requested feature is currently disabled

message.description: Response message, or error description when the request fails

credits.description: Estimated or actual number of credits the task will consume, as indicated by `estimated`.

estimated.description: Whether `credits` is an estimate. When true, the final charge is reconciled after task completion; when false, `credits` is the actual charge.

post.description: Accepts the same request parameters as `/api/v1/client/job/CreateTask`. Use the exact `model` and model-specific `input` payload documented for the task you want to estimate.

model.description: Model name. Use the same value required by the corresponding CreateTask endpoint.

callback_url.description: Optional callback URL accepted by CreateTask. It is not used because this endpoint does not create a task.

input.description: Model-specific input parameters. Use the same fields and values as the corresponding CreateTask request.

input.prompt: A futuristic laboratory with glowing blue holographic displays and a robotic assistant.
